name: Mikuni Manami
source:
She is the wife of Yuuichi, Yuji's older brother. In other words, his brother's wife. In short, a married woman.

A beautiful and cheerful woman whom Yuuji also secretly admires.

She accepted me in a good mood even though I had to live with her.

[spoiler] With the approval of her husband, she offers herself to the landlord for cheaper rent. [/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/tmhv.html]official site[/url]]
